units.source_text: 阿光一抬头，发现有人聚拢过来倾听她俩的谈话。

en.t: When A Guang looked up, she noticed that people had gathered around to listen to the two girls' conversation.

units.source_text: 刚才那个戴便帽的和那个系窄硬腰带的，不知什么时候又折回来，伫立在那里。

en.t: The man in the cap from before and the one wearing the narrow stiff sash had somehow come back and were standing there.
